run_play_coins: run the play_coins human player module with WASD movement and TAB to switch players
run_play_coins_level: run the play_coins module with a custom level name and observation type
run_play_coins_verbose: run the play_coins module in verbose mode with debug information printed
run_play_coins_settings: run the play_coins module with custom JSON settings for the environment
run_play_coins_events: run the play_coins module with event printing enabled
